name: Utility Billing and Assistance Agent
headline: Resolve billing questions with evidence while keeping account authority human
pitch: Bring synthetic balances, smart-meter history, leak-policy screening, payment options, and assistance criteria into one resident-service brief without changing a bill, plan, repair, enrollment, or account.
why_try: A billing specialist can ask about a disputed account and see the exact usage pattern, draft estimate, required evidence, and approval boundary in one response.
customer_challenge: Consumption records, billing policy, assistance criteria, and account status are reviewed manually across systems, slowing dispute resolution and creating inconsistent resident outcomes.
microsoft_ai_story: Microsoft Copilot Studio can coordinate governed review across a utility billing platform, advanced metering infrastructure, assistance case management, Outlook, Teams, and approved repair scheduling workflows.
business_value: Improves consistency of usage and billing-evidence review.
Makes assistance and payment-plan criteria easier to explain.
Preserves resident and municipal controls by keeping every account action behind authorized staff approval.
business_flow: Customer service representatives, billing specialists, assistance coordinators, and revenue supervisors
Assistance case management, Outlook, and Teams

capabilities.name: Read-only account explanation
capabilities.purpose: Summarizes synthetic balances, services, payment history, and account state without changing a record.

capabilities.name: Leak and usage screening
capabilities.purpose: Reviews synthetic meter history and drafts a policy estimate without diagnosing a leak or adjusting a bill.

capabilities.name: Draft payment-plan options
capabilities.purpose: Calculates non-binding installment options without creating an agreement.

capabilities.name: Resident assistance eligibility
capabilities.purpose: Screens the resident's income on file against synthetic program criteria and totals potential relief without determining eligibility or enrolling anyone.

capabilities.name: Leak adjustment credit draft
capabilities.purpose: Applies the Municipal Code 18.42 one-time leak adjustment to the smart-meter excess and drafts the credit and new bill for billing-specialist approval without adjusting the bill.

capabilities.name: Payment plan and application packet
capabilities.purpose: Drafts the payment plan and the pre-filled assistance application with required documents without creating a plan or submitting an application.

capabilities.name: Repair assistance program

capabilities.name: Complete assistance package
capabilities.purpose: Assembles the credit, plan, applications, and repair into a customer-ready draft and account notes without sending or changing anything.

capabilities.name: Preliminary household screening
capabilities.purpose: Compares supplied household facts with synthetic criteria without determining eligibility or enrolling an applicant.

prompts.label: Leak Adjustment Analyst: Leak adjustment credit draft
prompts.prompt: Does the Maple Drive household qualify for a leak credit, and how much would it be?

recorded_answer.prompt: Does the Maple Drive household qualify for a leak credit, and how much would it be?
recorded_answer.answer:
Yes — the Maple Drive account (RES-782MD) qualifies for a leak adjustment under Municipal Code 18.42.

**Draft credit: $97.80**
- Excess usage: 17,500 gallons above the 12-month baseline
- Excess re-billed at water-only rate ($2.20/1,000 gal), sewer charges waived on that portion
- Bill would drop from $184.50 → $86.70 (53% reduction)
- Requires repair proof (receipt/invoice) within 30 days
- One-time use only

This is a draft — a billing specialist still needs to approve and apply it. Want me to check assistance programs too, in case the $86.70 is still tough to cover?
